summary: Built the SL-039 design: a scanner-thread TopLevelTracker (src/FsAnalyser.Core/TopLevelTracker.cs) that seeds one row per root child at the root listing, credits every later committed listing to its row through a row index carried on the scanner's stack, moves in-place hardlink corrections to the corrected name's row, and publishes immutable TopLevelSnapshot/TopLevelRow objects (copied rows behind Array.AsReadOnly) on ScanProgress.TopLevel and a required ScanResult.TopLevel built in Run.Finish. The window shows them in a virtualized ListBox (two-TextBlock rows formatted by a converter, sorted largest-first on the UI thread, compared by reference, skip-one-tick after a refresh over 100 ms, final snapshot always shown), and --report gains a counts-only topLevel object plus window.TopLevelHeader. The hook gained watch and measure modes and FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS; WindowCases gained L-001 to L-003, a C-002 extension and a named-only M-001 measurement; 15 new Core tests pin row attribution, states, cancel at every guarded call, endings and snapshot immutability; the SL-039 architecture rules were narrowed and extended as the review required. Full Core suite 170/170, all 18 default window cases and HookCases pass; scan time against trunk -0.5% on a 196,583-entry tree, and the ListBox at 100,000 rows stayed well under the spike's limits.

files.why: Scanner-thread-owned, lock-free row accumulators: Seed at the root listing, FolderExited (the single pending/credit call per committed folder), Moved for in-place corrections, Finish always publishes the final snapshot; Debug.Assert on pending and on every total being credited.
Public immutable TopLevelSnapshot/TopLevelRow plus TopLevelKind/TopLevelState enums; constructor copies the rows and exposes them via Array.AsReadOnly (M3).

Carries the top-level row on the _pending stack tuple, seeds the tracker after the root listing, calls FolderExited once per committed folder beside the progress publish, calls Moved from Correct, and sets TopLevel in Run.Finish (the only ScanResult builder).
Adds required TopLevelSnapshot? TopLevel so a return path without the final snapshot cannot compile (m1).
Adds internal TopLevelInterval (default 250 ms; tests set zero).
New TopLevelPanel (header + virtualized TopLevelList with a two-TextBlock row template) as the last, filling child; OutcomePanel docked Top; UnreadableList MaxHeight 200.

Refresh rule (reference compare, sort, ItemsSource replace, Loaded-priority scroll restore and timing, skip-one-tick over 100 ms), ending always shows the final snapshot or clears, scan start clears; read-only internal state (ShownTopLevel, LastRefresh, SkippedRefreshes, SkipsNextRefresh); FormatSize/Count made internal for the converter.
IValueConverter that words a row's name/state and figures, so only realized rows are formatted.
Report built as an ordered dictionary; adds window.TopLevelHeader and a counts-only topLevel object counted from the rows the list holds (absent when the list shows nothing); schema stays 1.

watch mode (reads TopLevelList mid-scan by reflection, logs and presses Cancel), measure mode (refresh times + Input-priority probe p95/max, max realized containers), FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS pad for watch/measure.

C-002 extended with topLevel checks against the tree; new L-001 (live rows + Cancel + no names in report), L-002 (3,000 rows, virtualization, final snapshot after a skipped tick with skip armed), L-003 (empty/missing/relative root), M-001 (100k-row measurement, named only); tree builders and Invoke-HookedRun extras.
15 tests on real NTFS temp trees covering every owed Core case, with a shared snapshot checker (sums = running totals, forward-only states, settled rows frozen, final rows equal the store per entry).

SL-039 settled rules: store rule narrowed to allow post-scan result.Store and extended with \bStore\s*: (m8, verified against trunk); snapshot rule extended with I(List|Collection|Dictionary|Set)< and a public-field pattern ending (?!>) (M3); patterns made single-quoted.
Design note as built: settled decisions, deviations, tests, scan-time and 100k-row measurements, and what is left to the tree slice.

obligations.how: WindowCases L-001: hook watch mode waits until Cancel is pressable and TopLevelList holds a Folder row with Bytes>0 while another is NotRead, logs it (rows=20 folderBytes=458752 notRead=13 running=True in the last run), presses Cancel; the case also checks the final rows against core.
TopLevelTests.AHardlinkAcrossTwoTopFoldersIsChargedOnceToTheRowOfTheFirstName: 1-folder row holds 1 MiB and 1 file, 2-folder row 0 bytes and 1 file; rows equal Totals and the store per row.

TopLevelTests.AnInPlaceCorrectionOfAnEarlierNameIsCreditedToThatNamesRow: stale first name Done at 1 MiB, corrected to 64 MiB in 1-folder's row via tracker.Moved while 2-folder is listed; 2-folder shows 0 bytes in every snapshot. A Moved-no-op mutant fails it.

TopLevelTests.TopLevelLinksAreNotFollowedRowsWithNothingCounted: top-level junction, folder symlink and file symlink are Link/NotFollowed with 0 bytes in every snapshot; links created for real, never skipped (Q-001).

TopLevelTests.AFolderRowHoldingLinkFoldersIsDoneWhenTheScanCompletes: a top folder with a junction, a folder symlink and a cyclic junction plus ordinary subfolders goes Reading then Done with Folders=4; pending is raised only at the push site.
TopLevelTests.AnUnreadableTopFolderIsAnUnreadableRowAndTheScanCompletes: denied top folder is Unreadable with Folders=1, 0 bytes, UnreadableBelow 0; scan Completed, rows equal Totals.
TopLevelTests.AnUnreadableFolderDeeperInsideLetsItsRowFinishWithOneUnreadableBelow: row is Done with UnreadableBelow=1 and never changes after Done; a double-decrement mutant fails it.
TopLevelTests.CancelBetweenListingsLeavesAFinalSnapshotThatAddsUpToTheTotals: Cancel after the third listing leaves Final set, f0 StoppedPartway (the only one), 9 rows NotRead, rows equal Totals.

TopLevelTests.CancelAtAnyCallLeavesAFinalSnapshotThatAddsUpToTheTotals (before and during each guarded call, via SynchronousIoCancel.Created with BeforeCall/AfterCall, including every buffer of the deeper listing d\big and the repeat's probe): final equals the last published figures (an interrupted listing commits nothing; the case's original 'partial adds' why was corrected per M4's disposition) and rows equal Totals.

TopLevelTests.NothingToShowIsNoSnapshotOrAnEmptyOne feeds already-cancelled, missing root, a file as root (TopLevel null, no snapshots) and empty root (final, Completed, 0 rows); WindowCases L-003 checks the window for empty, missing and relative roots. The 'faults after snapshots were shown' sub-shape is only observable as C-012's exit 70 with no report; its list-clearing is not checked at window level (see not_built).

TopLevelTests.ASnapshotHeldEarlyNeverChangesWhileTheScanGoesOn: a snapshot held after the second listing reads identically at the end while every other row changed under new objects; Rows is not an array and setting an item throws NotSupportedException. An aliasing mutant fails it and 10 other tests.

WindowCases L-002: 3,000 top-level folders, every refresh padded to 150 ms by FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS, Cancel pressed only once a tick has skipped and the skip is armed again; checks at most a screenful of containers (5) and that the ending still showed the final snapshot. A mutant whose ending obeyed the skip failed it on final/reading/bytes/files.
WindowCases L-001 builds 20 folders named Recognizable-Top-NN and asserts no name (nor the prefix) appears anywhere in the report text; topLevel carries counts only.

M1 as disposed: one call per committed folder, TopLevelTracker.FolderExited(folder, row, unreadable: error != 0, pushed), made after the push loop in FolderDone (the only exit); aborted folders return before it and are never counted unreadable; Debug.Assert(pending >= 0).

The shared snapshot checker asserts that once a row is Done/Unreadable/NotFollowed its state and figures never change in any later snapshot, run on every TopLevelTests tree including the unreadable-deeper and link-folder trees; the only exemption is Bytes/OnDisk of a row reached by an in-place hardlink correction.

TopLevelSnapshot's constructor copies rows and exposes Array.AsReadOnly(copy); the fitness rule gained \bpublic\s+I(?:List|Collection|Dictionary|Set)< and the public-field pattern ending [;=](?!>) so expression-bodied properties do not match; checked with Python re against the file (clean) and planted violations (caught).

(1) Cancel in flight is fed through the existing SynchronousIoCancel.Created + BeforeCall/AfterCall seam at every guarded call, including a deeper multi-buffer listing (CancelAtAnyCall...). (2) Hook variable FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS pads each refresh so ticks skip; L-002 presses Cancel with the skip armed and checks the final snapshot was shown.
ScanResult.TopLevel is a required init property and Run.Finish, the only place a ScanResult is built, sets it from TopLevelTracker.Finish, which always publishes.

RefreshTopLevel compares with the shown snapshot by ReferenceEquals; StartScan's ClearTopLevel resets it; ScanProgress.TopLevel's doc states each scan has its own ScanProgress (MainWindow creates one per scan).

The top-row index is carried on the _pending stack tuple from the start (set when root children are pushed, inherited below), so per-listing lookup is O(1) with no store reads; the design note records that a scan-time miss would be per-listing cost, not publish cadence.

Hook measure mode + WindowCases M-001 at 100,000 rows: 4 runs, refresh p95 25.4-46.5 ms (max 64.3), Input p95 8.2-15.7 ms (max 88.9), 0 skipped, 5-6 containers; recorded against the 100/200 ms limits in docs/design/SL-039-live-results.md.

Ran the patterns over trunk (git show HEAD): the rule as appended matched result.Store.GetPath at MainWindow.xaml.cs:301; narrowed to '(?<!\bresult)\.Store\b', kept '\bScanStore\b', added '\bStore\s*:'; clean on trunk and the slice, and catches planted progress.Store, _result.Store, property-pattern and type-name uses.

deviations: The results list is in its own panel below the scanning and outcome panels, not inside ScanningPanel under CountersText as the design said: ScanningPanel collapses at every ending, and the design also requires the list and its after-Cancel/after-Completed headers to stay on screen. OutcomePanel is now docked Top (it was the filling child) and UnreadableList got MaxHeight 200, so the list, as the last child, gets bounded height and virtualizes.

'Credit on every exit from a listing, including an interrupted one' was not built: an aborted listing commits nothing and changes no running total (Scanner.cs remarks and line 139), so there is nothing to credit; O-001 was settled the same way. Case C-009's 'why' (partial adds already in the totals) was wrong; the test asserts instead that no row changes at the stop and rows still equal Totals, per the critique's M4 disposition.

M1 was built as the person's disposition, not the finding's wording: one FolderExited(folder, row, unreadable, pushed) call after the push loop in FolderDone, with a bool rather than a Listed/Unreadable/Interrupted outcome from a finally, because cancelled folders never reach it.

M2's invariant ('once Done, figures identical in every later snapshot') cannot hold as stated: when the first name of a hardlinked file is charged at a stale listing size, the repeat's probe corrects that record in place later, changing a Done row's Bytes/OnDisk (the counting rule's first-name charge). The checker exempts exactly those two figures for rows named as corrected; state, Files, Folders and UnreadableBelow stay frozen. Documented in the design note and TopLevelState.Done.

The report's topLevel key is present whenever the list shows a snapshot, with a 'final' flag, and is counted from the rows TopLevelList actually holds, rather than 'only when a final snapshot exists' from the result: at a correct ending these are the same, and this way a swallowed final snapshot shows as final=false instead of looking like a missing key. window.TopLevelHeader was also added (additive, schema 1).

The hook gained more than the design's watch mode: a measure mode (Input-priority probes and the window's own refresh times, needed for m7) and FSA_HOOK_SLOW_REFRESH_MS (needed for M4 part 2, watch/measure only). It reads MainWindow's read-only internal refresh state (LastRefresh, SkippedRefreshes, SkipsNextRefresh) and rows by reflection, since the hook shares no code with the app.

New window cases are named L-001..L-003 plus a named-only M-001 measurement, not in -Case All. The watch case uses a new tree of 20 folders named Recognizable-Top-NN with 1,500 subfolders each instead of New-LargeTree, so the no-names-in-report check (O-014) has recognizable names to look for.
Row lookup uses the stack-carried top-row index from the start (the m5 fallback) instead of a Parent walk per listing. The Parent walk is used only in Moved, once per corrected hardlink record.

The snapshot types live in namespace FsAnalyser.Core with their own TopLevelKind enum instead of reusing Store.EntryKind, so the window never needs the Store namespace. Rows is exposed as IReadOnlyList backed by a ReadOnlyCollection, per M3.
not_built: No window-level check that the list clears when the scan faults after rows were shown (hook 'throw' shape of C-010). In report mode the UI fault makes the app exit 70 with no report (C-012), and nothing in the shipped exe can make Scanner.Scan throw without a seam, which 'the shipped app carries no test seam' forbids. The clearing code is shared with the Could not read and rejected-root endings, which L-003 does check.

follow_ups: A person reruns the network pass (WindowCases.ps1 -Case All -IncludeNetwork, then Core.Tests filtered to Network=SMB-LOOPBACK): this slice changes MainWindow.xaml(.cs), src/FsAnalyser.Core/Scanning/**, tests/window/FsaWindowHook/** and tests/window/WindowCases.ps1, so under the SL-020 staleness rule the last pass is stale.

The person should settle the design's open question: whether a one-level list of the root's children closes PS-002's 'results fill in as it goes', or drill-down is expected. Drill-down needs the two spike prerequisites (store published before Finish with an ordered child-range publish; a consistent rollup read path), which the tree slice owns.

Decide whether the window should say that a Done row can still change when a hardlink's first name is corrected later. Today it shows no suffix for Done.

Eight leftover folders under %TEMP%\fsa-window-cases (two items each, created 10:59 to 16:37 on 2026-09-25, before this build) suggest a window case that sometimes does not remove its tree. They were left untouched.
